name: Bow
coatColor: Black coat with a white chest patch
background: Bow is a cheerful young Thai mixed-breed girl with a glossy black coat and a small white chest patch. She loves running and playing, and once she has a little time to feel safe with new people she becomes soft, affectionate, and deeply loving. A happy home with patient introductions would help her confidence shine.
sizeNote: Medium build; athletic and lean in the photos.
visualNote: Relaxed panting and loose posture suggest an energetic, friendly dog.

name: Gorya
coatColor: Sable tan, cream, and gray with white legs
background: Gorya is a people-focused young girl with a sable tan, cream, and gray coat, bright eyes, and a curled tail. She is affectionate, lively, and happiest when she can be close to people or run around outside. She can be selective with other dogs, so she may do best as the only dog or with slow introductions to a calm match.
sizeNote: Medium to large-leaning build; long-legged and active.
visualNote: Open mouth, forward stance, and alert expression suggest a confident, playful dog.

name: CJ
coatColor: White coat with tan patches and speckled legs
background: CJ is a cheerful, extremely playful young boy with a white coat, tan patches, and lightly speckled legs. He is friendly with people, enjoys meeting new friends, and loves running and playing. He also gets along well with other dogs, making him a lively social companion for an active home.
sizeNote: Medium build with a slim, athletic frame.
visualNote: Standing alert outdoors with bright body language; best fit for a home that enjoys activity.

name: Nadine
coatColor: Black puppy coat with subtle brown highlights
background: Nadine is a bright little puppy with a black coat and soft brown highlights. She was found abandoned at Laem Mae Phim Beach, but she remains curious, friendly, and open-hearted. She likes exploring new spaces and would thrive with a family ready to guide a young puppy with kindness and routine.
sizeNote: Small puppy now; likely to grow into a medium adult.
visualNote: Perky ears, curious stance, and forward movement suggest a playful puppy with growing confidence.

name: Nana
coatColor: Tan and black saddle coat with cream markings
background: Nana is a sweet young Thai mixed-breed girl with a tan face, black saddle markings, and expressive eyes. Her photos show an attentive, friendly dog who looks eager to interact. For the prototype profile, she is presented as a curious, playful companion who would enjoy gentle training and regular walks.
sizeNote: Medium young build; still filling out.
visualNote: Soft eye contact and relaxed panting suggest a friendly, people-aware temperament.

name: Nash
coatColor: Light tan coat with cream chest and muzzle
background: Nash is a light tan young boy with a sturdy frame, cream chest, and calm, observant body language. The video frames show him exploring the yard with confidence rather than rushing around. For the demo profile, he is a gentle, steady companion who would enjoy space to sniff, walk, and build a bond with his people.
sizeNote: Large-leaning young build; sturdy but not heavy.
visualNote: Video frames show relaxed exploring and alert interest in the surroundings.

name: Naya
background: Naya is a playful black puppy with a fluffy coat and a bright, curious expression. She was found abandoned at Laem Mae Phim Beach, but she remains happy, innocent, and ready to trust again. She loves exploring and would be a joyful match for a family ready for puppy energy.
sizeNote: Small puppy now; likely to grow into a medium adult.
visualNote: Bouncy posture and alert ears suggest a playful, curious puppy.

name: Nicola
coatColor: Tan and gray saddle coat with cream face
background: Nicola is a gentle young Thai mixed-breed girl with a tan and gray saddle coat, cream face, and soft eyes. Her photos show a friendly, approachable dog who seems interested in people without looking overly intense. For the prototype, she is a sweet, easy-going companion who would enjoy calm affection and daily walks.
visualNote: Loose mouth and soft expression suggest a friendly, moderate-energy dog.

name: Nid
coatColor: Cream puppy coat with tan ears
background: Nid is a tiny cream-colored puppy with tan ears and a very affectionate personality. She was found abandoned at Laem Mae Phim Beach and is now safe in shelter care. She likes calling for attention, walking around curiously, and staying close to people, making her a tender little companion for a patient home.
sizeNote: Very small puppy now; likely to grow into a small-to-medium adult.
visualNote: Video frames show gentle exploring and people-oriented attention seeking.

name: Rambo
coatColor: Light cream and tan coat with darker muzzle
background: Rambo is a young shelter-raised boy with a light cream and tan coat and a darker muzzle. He is bright, friendly, and enjoys being around both people and other dogs. His video and photos show him exploring, running, and staying engaged with his surroundings, so he would suit a home that enjoys playful puppy energy.
sizeNote: Medium puppy build; likely to keep growing.
visualNote: Video frames show active sniffing, trotting, and curious exploration.

name: Roselyn
coatColor: Tan coat with black muzzle and white chest
background: Roselyn is a sweet, social young girl with a tan coat, black muzzle, and white chest. She loves running, playing, splashing in water, and spending time with older dogs. She would be a joyful companion for a family that can give her playtime, gentle structure, and plenty of affection.
sizeNote: Small-to-medium puppy build; likely to grow into a medium adult.
visualNote: Relaxed open-mouth expressions and playful sitting posture suggest a happy, social puppy.

name: Thalia
coatColor: Long dark brown and black coat with tan legs
background: Thalia is a gentle young girl with a longer dark brown and black coat and tan legs. She can be shy at first and needs time to trust new people, but once she feels safe she becomes loving, attached, and very loyal. She would do best with a patient adopter who can offer calm routines and reassurance.
sizeNote: Large-leaning build with a longer coat.
visualNote: She faces the camera with a softer, reserved stance; best presented as gentle rather than high-energy.
